values.reopens: no date set (park page); closed through the 2027 season per ctparks.com/camping
values.note: Closed since the August 2024 flood, which damaged the park access roads and washed out the bridge on the campground road. The park page says closed for the 2026 season with no reopening date; DEEP's camping page says closed for the 2026-2027 seasons (both read 2026-11-11). Day-use areas stay open.

status.source: https://ctparks.com/parks/kettletown-state-park ('The campground and surrounding areas ... are closed, and will remain closed for the 2026 season. A reopening date has not yet been determined.') + https://ctparks.com/camping ('The Kettletown State Park Campground will remain closed for the 2026-2027 seasons due to flood damages sustained during an unprecedented heavy rainfall event in August 2024.') + ReserveAmerica parkId 100109 ('The flooding caused extensive damage to the park access roads, and washed out the bridge on the campground road. The campground will remain closed for the 2026 season.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: $17 a night for a Connecticut resident, $27 for a non-resident, as posted while the campground is closed. $9 reservation fee. ctparks.com park page, read 2026-11-11.
Only 15 standard sites take a rig over 20 ft: 002, 003 and 054 (24 ft), 007, 055 and 057 (26 ft), 009, 023-028, 056 and 061 (28 ft). The rest take 10-20 ft.

sites.source: https://ctparks.com/parks/kettletown-state-park ('61 partially wooded and open sites'; '55 RV/Tent Sites'; 'Maximum length for trailers/RVs: 28 feet') + https://ctparks.com/camping ('Trailers and RV's may not exceed 28' in length') + ReserveAmerica parkId 100109 site list (29 STANDARD NON ELECTRIC 16-28 ft, 12 tent-only, 5 popup/tent, 6 cabins, 1 ADA electric), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://ctparks.com/parks/kettletown-state-park ('Bathhouses with showers'; 'Dumping station (free for registered campers)') + ReserveAmerica parkId 100109 amenities ('Flush Toilet', 'Water Drinking') + DEEP map (Water symbols), read 2026-11-11

note: In Kettletown State Park on Lake Zoar near Southbury. Most sites are short: only standard sites 002, 003, 007, 009, 023-028, 054-057 and 061 are posted at 24-28 ft; the rest are 20 ft or less. Campers may launch car-top boats. No pets or alcohol. --Claude
summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica + 2015 map + imagery: still temporarily closed (flood damage; the park page says 2026 with no reopening date, the camping page 2026-2027; both recorded); $17/$27 confirmed; 61 sites, 28-ft cap now manual, only 15 standard sites over 20 ft; showers, flush toilets, water, dump; phones found; note rewritten (wrong site counts corrected, closure moved to status).
flags: STATUS: still temporarily closed. Two official DEEP wordings differ on the reopening: the park page says 'will remain closed for the 2026 season. A reopening date has not yet been determined.'; ctparks.com/camping says 'will remain closed for the 2026-2027 seasons'. Both recorded in status.reopens/note. ReserveAmerica shows 'Closed through Wed Nov 11 2026' and a reservation window from Thu Nov 12 2026 to Mon Oct 11 2027, which contradicts the camping page's 2027 closure; I did not test whether 2027 nights can actually be booked (unread).

FIT: only 15 of the 29 standard sites take more than 20 ft (002, 003, 054 at 24 ft; 007, 055, 057 at 26 ft; 009, 023-028, 056, 061 at 28 ft; site 023 has a 40-ft driveway but a 28-ft vehicle limit). The old note's '30 RV/tent sites, of which 17 take rigs of 24-28 ft' and 'about 50 sites' were wrong against the park page (61 sites, 55 RV/tent) and the RA list (15), and are dropped.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): ReserveAmerica tags sites 009-017 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (Lake Zoar), and the park page calls it 'a lakeside campground'. Only site 009 (28 ft) fits a 23-ft rig; 010-017 are 20 ft. DEEP's map puts 9-17 on the lake side of the south loop; on leaf-off imagery the band between the site row along the road and the shore is about 40-55 m of deciduous woods, with no open ground to the water. Recommend not waterfront stays (at most lakeview in leaf-off season); revisit if the reviewer wants a one-site caveat.
HOOKUPS (not written): the only hookup site is ADA site 049 (map: 'ADA Site (Water & Electric Hookups) - 49'; RA 15-amp), which takes 14 ft, so it does not fit a 23-ft rig. Left unset.
PHONE: stored empty. ctparks lists 'Campground Office: 203-264-5678', and the park contact block gives 'May – Sept. (203) 264-5678' and 'Sept. – May (203) 938-2285' (DEEP's page for this park).
